# `aitbc governance profile show`

Show a DAO governance profile by user ID (coordinator API read).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance profile show [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--user-id` | text | — | yes | User ID the profile belongs to |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance profile show --user-id <user_id>
```
